svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blade 36 wide, 6 thick (half of 12), 310 long below the collar,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a wedge tip 16 wide and 30 long between the electrode grooves.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Half collar 42 dia x 4; half spigot 35.4 dia x 11 on top of it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Windows 19 wide x 80 long, centred 150 and 300 mm below grade

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (the upper window ends at the collar).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Board slots 23.2 wide x 0.9 deep, 100 long, for the probe edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wire channels 3.5 wide x 2.5 deep, centred 14.75 each side,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from 15 mm above the foot up through the spigot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Temperature probe bore 6.2 dia, centred 15.4 from the centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: open to the edge, 200 to 250 below grade.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Electrode grooves 4.1 dia, 24 apart, 15 deep into the foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mirror of the front half without the electronics pockets.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Its slots, channels, bore and grooves must line up with the front half:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: check by laying the two halves face to face before gluing.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no stringing in the channels; 4 mm rod drops into its groove.
